comment: Regression guard for the partial-submit checkbox bug. A checkbox watched by an AjaxObserveField (partial submit) must round-trip BOTH ways: unchecking it submits nothing so the server reads OFF; re-checking submits its value so the server reads ON. The serializer used to send the checkbox value regardless of checked state, so toggling OFF never registered server-side. The container echoes the server's view of the boolean.

steps.text: Uncheck it - the partial submit must send NOTHING for the box, so the server reads OFF.

steps.name: unchecking round-trips: server now sees OFF

steps.text: Re-check it - now the box submits its value, server reads ON again.

steps.name: re-checking round-trips: server sees ON again
the observe field fired on each toggle (>=2 changes)
